trust_decision.summary: The ORDER BY direction value from caller-supplied orderBy maps is trusted and concatenated into SQL. The platform-level getOrderByExpression decides it with no allow-list (base SQL platform, MySQL/MariaDB override, MSSQL override).

landing_point.why: A search for orderBy direction handling leads from QueryBuilderHelper.getQueryOrderFromObject (packages/sql/src/query/QueryBuilderHelper.ts:1014) to the base getOrderByExpression, which concatenates direction.toLowerCase().

fix_sites.entry_point: em.find/findOne/findAll/findByCursor/Collection.load/matching and qb.orderBy/andOrderBy with an orderBy map (sqlite, libsql, postgresql, pglite, oracledb inherit this)
same public APIs on @mikro-orm/mysql and @mikro-orm/mariadb drivers

fix_sites.module_kind: dialect override in separate driver package (packages/mssql)

fix_sites.entry_point: new shared helper validateOrderByDirection added to AbstractSqlPlatform

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/mssql/src/MsSqlPlatform.ts:322-337 (separate driver package; switch on known values with default branch that still concatenates direction at :335); also packages/sql/src/dialects/mysql/BaseMySqlPlatform.ts:168-180

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The MSSQL override already switches on the QueryOrder enum, and the MySQL override strips whitespace with a regex (packages/sql/src/dialects/mysql/BaseMySqlPlatform.ts:177), so both look sanitised. A solver testing on sqlite could argue that only the base implementation is affected. This is weak: the default branch at packages/mssql/src/MsSqlPlatform.ts:335 is plainly raw, and fixing the single caller in QueryBuilderHelper covers all dialects at once.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: All 12 QueryOrder enum spellings (upper/lower case, the four NULLS FIRST/LAST forms) and numeric 1/-1 (QueryOrderNumeric) must keep working, as must raw()/sql`` fragment keys whose direction is still validated. An over-broad fix (rejecting spaces, upper case, numbers or raw keys) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: direction with leading/trailing whitespace (trimmed by the fix, fix.diff:2224)
direction on a raw()/sql fragment key (packages/sql/src/query/QueryBuilderHelper.ts:979-983)
array of order maps / nested array direction (packages/sql/src/query/QueryBuilderHelper.ts:960-961, 1011-1012)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An Oracle-specific getOrderByExpression override (e.g. NULLS emulation like MSSQL) with a raw default branch
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MySQL and MSSQL already override this for NULLS FIRST/LAST emulation (packages/sql/src/dialects/mysql/BaseMySqlPlatform.ts:168, packages/mssql/src/MsSqlPlatform.ts:322), so a dialect override in another driver package is idiomatic.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A partition-limit row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ...) builder that formats direction itself instead of calling helper.getQueryOrder
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already hand-builds a raw window clause; a maintainer could easily inline direction formatting there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A lower-level public orderBy(column, direction) overload on NativeQueryBuilder that concatenates direction
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: NativeQueryBuilder.orderBy already accepts a raw string and is emitted verbatim at packages/sql/src/query/NativeQueryBuilder.ts:466-467.

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89) via ORDER BY direction keyword position

services: none for sqlite/libsql tests (in-memory); MySQL/MariaDB/MSSQL/Postgres/Oracle servers needed to exercise those dialects end-to-end
O10_build.project_tests: tests/issues/*.test.ts with in-memory sqlite (the fix adds tests/issues/GHx59.test.ts); per-dialect QueryBuilder tests need DB services, but platform.getOrderByExpression SQL generation can be unit-tested offline

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Patch only the base AbstractSqlPlatform.getOrderByExpression, missing the MySQL and MSSQL overrides. The alternative, validating once in QueryBuilderHelper.getQueryOrderFromObject, actually covers every dialect.

out_of_scope_notes: Index DDL emits col.nulls / sort from entity metadata (packages/sql/src/schema/SchemaHelper.ts:462); this is developer-controlled metadata, not orderBy input.
The MongoDB driver maps a string direction to 1/-1 (packages/mongodb/src/MongoConnection.ts:254); no string reaches the query.
Cursor pagination normalises direction to 'asc'/'desc' (packages/core/src/drivers/DatabaseDriver.ts:337-339) before it reaches SQL.
